summary: Triple Flag Precious Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release announcing amendments to its existing undrawn revolving credit facility. The facility was increased from $700M to $1B with an additional $300M uncommitted accordion and improved pricing, with SOFR plus 1.325%-2.75% per annum. The facility matures in May 2030. National Bank of Canada acts as Administrative Agent, with a syndicate of eight banks. This refinancing is a routine corporate finance activity, not a special situation.
